title: EnvelopeFile: rcpt_to field is Vec<String>; wire protocol uses &[&str]
description: enqueue() takes rcpt_to: &[&str] but EnvelopeFile stores rcpt_to: Vec<String>. This forces an allocation+clone on every enqueue: rcpt_to.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(). This is a necessary allocation for the JSON file write, so the clone is justified. However, the field in RelayEnvelope (relay_client.rs) is also Vec<String>, and try_deliver_one clones from EnvelopeFile into RelayEnvelope. Callers who already have Vec<String> (the deliver path) are forced through two Vec<String> allocations. Worth noting; not a blocker.
